**Summary:** El Puerto de Santa María has no dedicated IT conference circuit. The research found: one local smart-city tech event on June 11 2026 (Gestión de Territorios Inteligentes, at Palacio Juan de Araníbar — also the day El Puerto receives Spain's inaugural Smart Territory distinction), the CEEI Bahía de Cádiz EU innovation centre which runs ad-hoc tech jornadas from its local campus, a regional WordPress community (180 members) active in Cádiz/Jerez, and CADIZ.RED (October, Jerez). For proper IT conferences, Seville (~80 km) is the nearest hub with CTx Tech Experience (March 2026, 400+ speakers) and 5G Forum (May 2026, 85 speakers, 80+ orgs). 11 citations written to `citations.jsonl`; cover SVG generated.
